scout_instructions.screening_threshold: Rough gross yield must be >= target_yield_minimum (10%) to pass to RESEARCH. Reject below 10%. Note: prior PCB units with 19%+ gross still failed underwriting after HOA + STR management — prefer lower HOA / stronger LTR when choosing among siblings.
scout_instructions.defer_non_us_markets: Do not add new Manta/Cuenca/international RESEARCH candidates until all US ACTIVE markets in market_sweep_order have ≥3 RESEARCH candidates or a documented dry-market note in scout_notes. International READY_FOR_UNDERWRITING backlog stays parked.

strategy: Filter each market for Condo / Condominium only before SFH or townhouse.
When a bulk scrape exists, filter property_type=condo and sort/group by address pattern before open-web search.
Prefer beds≥2 and price_range from property_filters when scoring scrape inventory.
Among PCB scrape clusters, rank by median advertised HOA on beds≥2 in price band (not all-condo samples — studios/1BR skew HOA low).
PCB beds≥2 start order: 8700 Front Beach Rd → 17462 Front Beach (Horizon South siblings) → other Front Beach mid-HOA clusters → Shores/Laketown last.
Do not prioritize 15100 Front Beach for beds≥2 — median HOA ~$1,261 on 2BR+; sub-$500 HOA rows are mostly 0–1BR (outside beds_min).
Search by building name or street address when a condo complex has multiple active listings.
When one unit in a building passes yield screen, review other units in the same building.
Prefer established condo buildings (20+ units) with published HOA fees on the listing.
Among sibling units, prefer lower advertised HOA and clearer LTR rent support (lesson from Laketown Wharf 9.0% reject).
Record building_name and unit in meta.json when available.
building_signals: Multiple units for sale in same building
Lower price per sqft vs neighborhood SFH

hoa_screening.quick_adjusted_yield: For condos with stated HOA, also compute (monthly_rent - hoa_monthly) * 12 / price; flag if below 8% even when gross yield passes.
